name: Switcher
description: Swipeable view that animates between child widgets along a chosen axis.
notes: The fractional position is an AnimationController value; the old AnimatedValueBuilder(value:, duration:) pair was replaced.
children is asserted non-empty and index is clamped, so an out-of-range index no longer throws a RangeError.
preview.dart imports clickable and the button component; preview files are excluded from dependency checking.
